verdict.rationale: SAM.gov has no native automation or scheduling feature in the evidence. It only offers building blocks for externally built automations: REST APIs keyed to accounts, System Accounts for machine access, and async extract jobs whose download URL can be emailed (emailId=Yes). Any autonomous background workflow therefore has to be built and scheduled with outside tools. Missing for 10: native scheduled or triggered automations, saved-search alerts or webhooks, in-product background job management, any agent-oriented automation tooling, independent corroboration.
